name: dsh-alexandrie
description: Alexandrie-style knowledge base for the DSH Web GUI: workspaces, nested documents, extended Markdown editor with live preview, full-text search, command palette, kanban board, free-form media canvas, Obsidian-style mind graph, tags, favourites and trash. Installs through the official DSH plugin system.
